scope: Real installed Chrome canonical density and retained interaction checks at DPR 1 and 2 for all 26 B1 moons and the two refreshed parent packages. This is not a full-cohort visual acceptance or aggregate readiness claim.

environment.server: Final integrated diagnostic DEV server, after the full production build completed. Production aggregate browser evidence is separate.
environment.launcher: Per-attempt wrapper execs the installed Chrome, retaining stdout/stderr in a regular file while preserving Playwright CDP descriptors 3 and 4. No interaction assertions were relaxed.

evidencePortability.artifacts: Reports, videos, process logs and wrappers remain at the repository-relative output paths listed below. They are intentionally not copied into Git. Executable paths describe the capture host.
evidencePortability.networkLimit: Conformance records canonical requested URLs, not response-body hashes. The local asset hashes independently match the retained runtime manifests; they are not retrospectively asserted as captured network-response hashes.
evidencePortability.pinTiming: Each lane bound the runtime and eight shared inputs during capture. Additional package/source/renderer/navigation files are pinned during assembly at the same unchanged implementation HEAD; the scoped tracked diff was empty. Local ignored prepared descriptors are separately bound by descriptor digests.
scopeLimits: Natural-clock browser interactions do not establish native pixel parity, measurement accuracy or source-model adequacy.
Scientific source review and full package/build/browser gates remain separate evidence.
Historical parent/body caches are not all rebaked or qualified by these cases.
The first final Paaliaq attempt is retained and excluded because Vite optimizer 504 browser errors violated the zero-diagnostics gate. Its clean second attempt is the accepted evidence.
